blind.B1: Yes. The paper (Fig. 7, S7.p1, S9.15.p1) tests voluntary wheel running in early-life midazolam (MDZ) exposed mice. Exercise-carrying sequenced samples: RUN_MDZ_8w rep1-3 (GSM5068542-44). GSE166322 also holds P10 and in vitro Egr1 NSC libraries that do not carry the exercise factor; no Ctrl+RW RNA-seq is deposited.
blind.B2: 8w Nestin-EGFP+ NSC RNA-seq: Ctrl n=3, MDZ n=3, MDZ+RW n=3. Exercise contrast MDZ+RW vs MDZ (Fig. 7B), overlapped with MDZ vs Ctrl at 8w (Fig. 3E; q<0.05, FC>=1.5; 604 up, 873 down). P10 Ctrl vs MDZ (n=3 each; 172 DEGs) and Egr1 vs Ctrl in vitro are other questions.
blind.B3: No repeated measures. Each library pools 30,000 cells from several mice (S9.10.p1); no animal ID in metadata; packet A candidate pairing keys link no samples or only suffix-of-title replicate letters that are not animals.
blind.B4: The paper does not say whether groups were fitted jointly or pairwise; it says only that DESeq2 (default Wald, two-group comparisons) was used (S9.11.p1).
blind.B5: q < 0.05 and fold change >= 1.5 (S3 legend, Fig. 3E: 'fold change >= 1.5'); Fig. 7B legend: 'fold change > 1.5, q < 0.05'. P10 DEGs q<0.05 (n=172). Counts: 8w MDZ vs Ctrl 604 up / 873 down; Fig. 7B overlaps 42 and 76 genes; no total count for MDZ+RW vs MDZ.

checks.evidence: Run with 8w Ctrl/MDZ/RunMDZ; matches B1 (Fig. 7A, S7.p1). In vivo wheel running, so not an in vitro mediator design.
Ctrl 3 (GSM5068526-28), MDZ 3 (529-31), RunMDZ 3 (542-44) match the paper's n=3; P10 and in vitro samples excluded with reasons. Exercise arm is compared with MDZ, the paper's control for Fig. 7B.

Primary contrast grp_RunMDZ_vs_MDZ has treatment=RunMDZ, control=MDZ, which is correct. The mechanical flag fires on the secondary grp_Ctrl_vs_MDZ (treatment Ctrl, control MDZ), the reverse of the paper's MDZ vs Ctrl (Fig. 3E). Its design note says so and HANDBACK converts it (1671 up in MDZ, 301 down), so no direction-dependent statement is wrong. Residual risk: the compared table is named in the opposite order to the paper.
checks.fix: Optionally re-order the secondary contrast as treatment=MDZ, control=Ctrl (name grp_MDZ_vs_Ctrl) so the table, paper_counts key and HANDBACK share the paper's sign; no re-run of the primary is needed.

checks.evidence: Independent pooled libraries (S9.10.p1); no repeated animal; no usable pairing key in packet A.

Paper is silent on joint vs pairwise (S9.11.p1). One joint limma model on 9 samples was used and declared; counts differ from the paper but the paper's method (DESeq2 on counts) is blocked, so this is not attributable to fit structure alone.
RUN_MDZ libraries have later GSM ids, suggesting a separate batch; recorded as a caveat in study and covariance. No batch variable exists to model. Sex check passed.
GEO data_processing says TPM; log2(TPM+1) + limma is the declared route; counts not deposited and not faked from TPM. frac_p_gt_0.9 = 0.052, frac_p_lt_0.05 = 0.283 for Ctrl vs MDZ, no pile-up near 1.

padj<0.05 and |log2FC|>0.585 (strict), matching the Fig. 7B legend 'fold change > 1.5, q < 0.05'; S3 writes '>= 1.5'. At n=3 the FC cutoff is not binding (audit equals applied). No alternative rule in the packet table fits the paper's 1477 better.

The paper's 1477 (MDZ vs Ctrl) is set against the same contrast; the inverted up/down balance and the differing Fig. 7B overlaps (80 vs 42, 16 vs 76) are reported openly. HANDBACK claims only significance of overlaps, which the numbers show.
No stop or refusal; only the DESeq2-on-counts route is recorded as blocked because counts are not in GEO, which is true (only per-sample TPM files in the RAW tar).

human_items: Open policy: joint vs pairwise fit when the paper is silent.

The up/down balance of MDZ vs Ctrl is inverted relative to the paper (1671 up / 301 down vs 604 up / 873 down); cause (TPM+limma vs counts+DESeq2, or mislabelled GEO titles) cannot be settled from the files.
summary: 主要对比 RunMDZ vs MDZ 的方向、分组（各 n=3）和阈值都与论文一致，整体通过。机械标记只落在次要对比 grp_Ctrl_vs_MDZ，它与论文的 MDZ vs Ctrl 顺序相反，但已在设计说明和 HANDBACK 中声明并换算，属于轻微问题，建议改为 MDZ vs Ctrl 的顺序。MDZ 对 Ctrl 的上下调比例与论文相反，原因无法从文件判断，留给人工。
